00201 inline double besselI0(double p) throw()
00202 {
00203   static const int ITERLIMIT=15;
00204   static const double CONVERGE=1.0E-8;
00205   
00206   p = p/2;
00207   double n = 1, t = 1, d = 1;
00208   int k = 1;
00209   double v;
00210   
00211   do {
00212     n = n * p;           d = d * k;
00213     v = n / d;           t = t + v * v;
00214   } while ((++k < ITERLIMIT) && (v > CONVERGE));
00215   
00216   return t;
00217 }

00271 inline double ceil(double a) throw()  { int n = (int)a; return (double)(n+1); }
00272 inline float ceil(float a) throw()    { int n = (int)a; return (float)(n+1); }
00273 inline double floor(double a) throw() { int n = (int)a; return (double)n; }

00275 inline double frac(double a) throw()  { int n = (int)a; return a - (double)n; }

00277 inline double sign(double a) throw()  { int n = (a == 0.0) ? 0 : (a < 0.0) ? -1 : 1; return (double)n; }
00278 inline float sign(float a) throw()    { int n = (a == 0.f) ? 0 : (a < 0.f) ? -1 : 1; return (float)n; }
